title: corybas rotundifolius
intro: Corybas rotundifolius, commonly known as the helmet orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Corybas rotundifolius include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and diuretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties and are currently being studied for their potential in the development of new pharmaceuticals.
